name: resizable-table
title: Resizable table
description: Table whose columns resize by dragging the header edge or with the arrow keys. Scrolls sideways when wider than the card.
htmlExample: <bef-resizable-table class="w-[38rem] max-w-full" :columns='[{"key":"name","header":"Employee","width":180},{"key":"role","header":"Role","width":160},{"key":"city","header":"City","width":130},{"key":"salary","header":"CTC","width":110,"align":"right"}]' :rows='[{"name":"Aarav Mehta","role":"Senior Engineer","city":"Bengaluru","salary":"₹32.0L"},{"name":"Diya Nair","role":"Product Designer","city":"Mumbai","salary":"₹24.5L"},{"name":"Kabir Rao","role":"Engineering Manager","city":"Hyderabad","salary":"₹48.0L"},{"name":"Meera Iyer","role":"People Partner","city":"Pune","salary":"₹19.0L"}]'></bef-resizable-table>
